name: git_worktree
description: Transactional multi-file changes via git worktree: isolated branch, apply changes, optional verify command, commit, ff-only merge, cleanup. Zero pollution of working tree; rollback on failure. For git repos.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: project root (abs). Must be a git repository.

delete.description: Set true to delete the file

changes.description: REQUIRED: list of file changes to apply transactionally

message.description: Commit message (default: tongtian: multi-file change (N files))

verify_cmd.description: Optional shell command run in the worktree before commit; non-zero exit aborts and rolls back
